# Lead Finder

Finds angel investor leads from Crunchbase, enriches emails via Hunter.io, and posts each qualified lead to Slack for review.

## Setup
Open the **Config** node (first node after triggers) and fill in your API keys and settings. Everything is in that one node — no env vars or Enterprise plan needed.

## How to run
Click **Execute Workflow** manually. Or toggle the Schedule Trigger on to run daily at 6 AM PT.

## What you see in Slack
One message per qualified lead with name, company, email, confidence score, and Crunchbase categories.

## Crunchbase cookie
The cookie expires every few days. When leads stop flowing, log into crunchbase.com in Chrome, open DevTools (F12) → Network tab → reload → click any request → copy the full Cookie header value → paste into the Config node.
